title: Cheeky Brat
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuki Machida, eldest of five siblings and manager of her high school basketball team, has learned to keep her feelings to herself. Sho Naruse, a teasing first-year player, learns of her crush on the captain, supports her through it, and then sets out to win her over; the story follows them into university. Yen Press publishes it in English; age rating not confirmed (to verify).
life_message: It holds up honesty about one's feelings and persistent, supportive love as the way to grow up.
